description: This Java source file defines the WorkEffortSearchSession class, which manages search options, constraints, and session state for work effort searches within the OFBiz framework. It includes nested classes for search options, methods for processing search parameters, and session management functions.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearchSession
classes.description: Main class managing session-based search options and constraints for work effort searches.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearchOptions
classes.description: Serializable nested class representing search options, including constraints, sort order, and view settings.

methods.name: getWorkEffortSearchOptions
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the current search options from the session.

methods.name: processSearchParameters
methods.description: Processes incoming search parameters from a request, updating session search constraints and settings accordingly.

methods.name: searchAddConstraint
methods.description: Adds a search constraint to the session's current search options.

methods.name: searchSetSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for search results in the session.

methods.name: getSearchOptionsHistoryList
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the history list of search options in the session.

methods.name: searchGetConstraintStrings
methods.description: Returns a list of human-readable constraint descriptions for display.

methods.name: searchGetSortOrderString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current sort order.

methods.name: checkSaveSearchOptionsHistory
methods.description: Saves the current search options to history if they have changed.

methods.name: searchRemoveConstraint
methods.description: Removes a constraint at a specified index from the current search options.
